decision.title: OrderItem.book: per-item GET or the batched Book entity
decision.question: Review blocker (review.md finding 1): Lumen_Books_OrderItem.book is the field-level connector D-ox8zkp confirmed (GET /books/{bookId}, one request per order item), so lumen_books_orders(limit: 50) with many items per order sends one request per item, and Order.items has no documented maximum. Book is already an entity with a $batch connector (D-wnrxww, D-x1ekw6: GET /books?ids=...&limit=50, at most 50 ids). Keep the per-item field, or map book: { id: bookId } in the items selection of lumen_books_orders, lumen_books_order, lumen_books_createOrder and lumen_books_refundOrder so the router resolves it through the $batch connector (one request per 50 books), with the OrderItem link set include: false?

choices.label: Keep the field-level connector (one GET /books/{bookId} per order item)
Resolve OrderItem.book through the Book $batch entity connector
